title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten verified, admission-free ways to spend time together at Cal Poly Pomona, with student eligibility and seasonal access noted where applicable.

cards.entity_name: W. Keith & Janet Kellogg University Art Gallery
cards.title: Browse the Kellogg Gallery
cards.subtitle: Free public exhibitions beside the Bronco Student Center
cards.notes: Meet at Building 35A and browse the current exhibition together; confirm the semester schedule before making the walk across campus.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission art meetup in CPP’s principal university gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The university states that the Kellogg Gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | W. Keith & Janet Kellogg University Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public. The posted Spring 2026 schedule is Monday–Thursday, noon–5 p.m.; the gallery closes during breaks and between exhibitions, so verify current hours.

cards.title: See the Huntley Collection
cards.subtitle: A free fourth-floor gallery inside the University Library
cards.notes: Ride up to Library Room 4435 and compare favorite works; check the changing semester hours before gathering your group.
cards.short_summary: Western art and rotating displays in a compact, admission-free library gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The university states that the Huntley Gallery is always free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Don B. Huntley Gallery
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public. Located in University Library Building 15, Room 4435; hours vary by semester, and the gallery closes during breaks and installation periods.

cards.title: Walk BioTrek’s Outdoor Gardens
cards.subtitle: A self-guided public visit among environmental learning spaces
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a self-paced garden walk, yield to scheduled groups, and enter the rainforest only when its glasshouse doors are open.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor science-and-nature walk that visitors can take at their own pace.
cards.evidence_claim: BioTrek says its outdoor spaces are open to the public for self-guided visits at visitors’ leisure.
cards.source_title: Planning Your Visit | Rain Bird BioTrek
cards.access_notes: Outdoor spaces are open to the public for self-guided visits without an admission requirement. Scheduled tours have priority; rainforest access is available only when the glasshouse doors are open.

cards.entity_name: Cal Poly Pomona Self-Guided Walking Tour
cards.title: Take the Self-Guided Campus Tour
cards.subtitle: Explore CPP’s named landmarks on your own schedule
cards.notes: Open the university’s walking-tour route, gather at the Student Services Building, and let each person choose a landmark to discuss.
cards.short_summary: A flexible group walk through the campus core with no tour admission.
cards.evidence_claim: CPP explicitly permits visitors to tour campus on their own using its published self-guided walking tour.
cards.source_title: Campus Tours at Cal Poly Pomona
cards.access_notes: The self-guided tour itself requires no admission or purchase. Parking may require registration or payment; arrive without a car or use only a separately verified tour parking pass to keep the outing at zero dollars.

cards.title: Hold a Free Tutoring Meetup
cards.subtitle: Academic support open to every CPP student
cards.notes: Choose a shared course topic, bring the relevant assignment, and meet at the Learning Resource Center for no-cost academic support.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative study hang anchored by free campus tutoring.
cards.evidence_claim: CPP’s tutoring directory states that the Learning Resource Center is open and free to all CPP students.
cards.access_notes: Free to all CPP students. Consult the Learning Resource Center’s current service schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Climb at Bronco Peak
cards.subtitle: BRIC climbing and bouldering for enrolled students
cards.notes: Activate your BRIC membership, complete required waivers, and meet at the climbing wall for a beginner-friendly shared session.
cards.short_summary: A social climbing session on the BRIC’s 51-foot wall and bouldering area.
cards.evidence_claim: CPP says currently enrolled students receive free BRIC membership, and ASI identifies Bronco Peak as the BRIC climbing wall.
cards.source_title: Discover Campus Life at Cal Poly Pomona
cards.access_notes: Included with free BRIC membership for currently enrolled CPP students. Membership activation and waivers are required; students under 18 need a parent or guardian waiver.

cards.title: Swim Laps at the BRIC Pool
cards.subtitle: Ten lap lanes plus a recreational swim area
cards.notes: Check the pool schedule, activate your student membership, and meet for relaxed laps or conversation in the poolside lounge.
cards.short_summary: A no-extra-cost swim hang for currently enrolled students with active BRIC access.
cards.evidence_claim: CPP states that currently enrolled students get free BRIC membership; ASI documents the BRIC Pool’s lap lanes, recreational swim area, and lounge.
cards.source_title: Bronco Recreation and Intramural Complex Information
cards.access_notes: Pool access is included in BRIC membership, which CPP identifies as free for currently enrolled students. Activate membership first and check the current pool schedule and posted rules.

cards.title: Walk the Indoor Track Together
cards.subtitle: A three-lane elevated loop inside the BRIC
cards.notes: Set an easy conversational pace on the cushioned track, count 5.5 laps per mile, and follow the posted direction of travel.
cards.short_summary: A weather-independent walking meetup with mountain views from the elevated loop.
cards.evidence_claim: CPP states that enrolled students receive free BRIC membership, while ASI documents a three-lane indoor track where 5.5 laps equal one mile.
cards.source_title: Bronco Recreation and Intramural Complex Information
cards.access_notes: Included with free BRIC membership for currently enrolled CPP students. Membership activation is required; use the facility only during current operating hours.

cards.title: Join a Group Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Scheduled studio classes included with BRIC membership
cards.notes: Pick a class that suits everyone’s comfort level, reserve if the current schedule requires it, and arrive early enough to check in together.
cards.short_summary: A structured workout meetup in one of the BRIC’s five fitness studios.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI states that BRIC group fitness classes are regularly offered to members at no extra cost as part of membership; CPP says enrolled students get free membership.
cards.source_title: Bronco Recreation and Intramural Complex Information
cards.access_notes: Classes are offered to BRIC members at no extra cost, and CPP identifies membership as free for currently enrolled students. Verify the live class schedule, capacity, and any reservation requirement.

cards.title: Organize a BRIC Court Game
cards.subtitle: Basketball, volleyball, or badminton with student membership
cards.notes: Choose one court sport, confirm open-recreation availability, and meet with enough time to check out any included equipment.
cards.short_summary: A casual indoor game on the BRIC’s gymnasium or multi-activity courts.
cards.evidence_claim: CPP states that currently enrolled students receive free BRIC membership, and ASI identifies basketball, volleyball, and badminton as activities on the BRIC courts.
cards.source_title: Bronco Recreation and Intramural Complex Information
cards.access_notes: Court access is included with free BRIC membership for currently enrolled CPP students. Activate membership and verify open-recreation times because scheduled programs may occupy courts.
